_comment: soundmon style guides — proven prompt snippets appended to your description to steer the sound. The analog of pixelmon's styles.json. Combine them: --style impact,metal. Add your own; the key becomes the --style name.

ui.prompt: clean UI sound effect, short, crisp, digital interface, dry, no reverb
ui.negative: music, melody, reverb, long tail, ambience

impact.prompt: heavy impact, punchy transient, strong attack, thud, weighty

whoosh.prompt: fast whoosh, air movement, swoosh, doppler sweep

explosion.prompt: explosion, deep boom, debris, low-end rumble, sharp attack then decay

pickup.prompt: bright pickup sound, cheerful chime, collect item, short and rewarding

footstep.prompt: single footstep, foley, close-mic, dry, natural

door.prompt: door foley, hinge creak, latch click, wood and metal

weapon.prompt: weapon sound, metallic ring, sharp swing, blade

gun.prompt: gunshot, sharp crack, mechanical action, percussive

magic.prompt: magic spell effect, shimmering, ethereal sparkle, rising energy

machine.prompt: mechanical sound, servo, motor whir, industrial, gears

electric.prompt: electric zap, arcing electricity, crackling energy, high voltage

water.prompt: water sound, liquid, splash, flowing, bubbles

fire.prompt: fire sound, crackling flames, roaring burn, embers

glass.prompt: glass sound, sharp shatter, bright shards, brittle ring

ambience.prompt: ambient background loop, atmospheric bed, steady, immersive room tone
ambience.negative: music, melody, sudden transient, sharp attack

horror.prompt: unsettling horror sound design, dissonant, tense drone, eerie

arcade.prompt: retro arcade sound effect, synthesized bleep, square wave, 1980s video game

lofi8bit.prompt: lo-fi 8-bit sound effect, crunchy low sample rate, aliased and gritty, early DOS PC game sample, SoundBlaster era, harsh and dry
lofi8bit.negative: clean, high fidelity, smooth, orchestral, realistic, reverb

pcspeaker.prompt: PC speaker beep, 1-bit square wave buzzer, harsh monophonic tone, IBM PC internal speaker, no envelope
pcspeaker.negative: rich, realistic, reverb, orchestral, polyphonic, smooth

chiptune.prompt: 8-bit chiptune sound effect, NES 2A03 square wave and noise channel, short synthesized game blip, dry and punchy
chiptune.negative: realistic, acoustic, orchestral, high fidelity, reverb, ambience

nature.prompt: natural outdoor sound, organic, field recording, wildlife

vehicle.prompt: vehicle sound, engine, motor load, mechanical rumble

loop.prompt: seamless loop, continuous, no fade, consistent level throughout
loop.negative: fade in, fade out, sudden ending, one-shot

_music: pair these with --music, which drops the anti-music negative prompt

musicloop.prompt: seamless instrumental music loop, steady tempo, consistent, no vocals
musicloop.negative: vocals, singing, speech, fade out, tempo change

sting.prompt: short musical sting, a few seconds, decisive ending, instrumental
sting.negative: vocals, singing, long, ambient, sustained drone

drums.prompt: drum loop, tight groove, punchy kick and snare, steady tempo

chipmusic.prompt: chiptune music, NES 2A03 sound chip, square wave lead, triangle wave bass, noise channel percussion, catchy 8-bit video game melody, instrumental
chipmusic.negative: vocals, realistic instruments, orchestral, acoustic, live recording, reverb

gbmusic.prompt: Game Boy chiptune, DMG sound chip, two pulse channels, soft wave channel, buzzy noise percussion, lo-fi handheld video game music, instrumental
gbmusic.negative: vocals, orchestral, acoustic, realistic instruments, high fidelity

fmsynth.prompt: FM synthesis video game music, Sega Genesis YM2612, metallic FM bass, bright synth brass stabs, punchy digital drums, 16-bit era instrumental
fmsynth.negative: vocals, acoustic, orchestral, analog tape, live recording

adlib.prompt: AdLib OPL2 FM synthesis, 2-operator Yamaha YM3812, nasal buzzy synth brass and bell tones, gritty mono DOS game soundtrack, 1991 PC, instrumental
adlib.negative: vocals, acoustic, orchestral, realistic instruments, stereo width, reverb, high fidelity

opl3.prompt: Sound Blaster 16 OPL3 FM synthesis, 4-operator Yamaha YMF262, rich metallic FM brass stabs, detuned synth leads, punchy FM drums, mid-90s DOS game music, stereo, instrumental
opl3.negative: vocals, acoustic, orchestral, live recording, analog tape, lo-fi mono

tracker.prompt: Amiga MOD tracker music, demoscene, sampled 8-bit instruments, tight sequenced drums, hard-panned stereo, early 90s computer game music, instrumental
tracker.negative: vocals, orchestral, modern production, high fidelity

cinematic.prompt: cinematic orchestral music, strings and brass, dramatic, instrumental

_modifiers: shorthand qualities you can stack onto any of the above

big.prompt: large, cinematic, wide stereo, deep low end

small.prompt: small, delicate, subtle, close and quiet

clean.prompt: clean, high fidelity, well recorded, low noise floor

lofi.prompt: lo-fi, low sample rate, aliased, bit-crushed, gritty digital artifacts
